description: Seeded-pack 2x2 coding for all 15 Tier1 cases. pack_mentions_object = the artist's committed frame object appears in the INPUT pack (concept_memo.md / documentation.md / exhibition_record.md), even as a one-line association or theme label. copilot_took_as_frame = the reconstruction's central provocation takes that object as its frame (not merely a mechanism mention). Coding is conservative: when unsure, pack_mentions_object = true if any clear thematic keyword of the gold frame appears in the pack. Objects appearing ONLY in LEAKAGE_AUDIT.md (i.e. withheld) are coded false.

cases.artist_object: Revitalizing classic photographic printing as cultural lineage; photography's cultural significance and the joy of materializing scenery as a physical print
cases.evidence_pack: applying digital and computational tools to classic alternative photographic printing processes - specifically salt print, platinum print, and cyanotype
cases.evidence_recon: The organizing idea of this work is the latent image as forecast.

cases.artist_object: Sisterhood and the feminist challenge to patriarchal perceptions carried by a women-made script
cases.evidence_pack: Nushu - a script historically created and used by women in 19th-century Hunan Province, China
cases.evidence_recon: Where prior framings of women-made script and machine language exist in the literature, we set them aside in favor of the legibility argument

cases.artist_object: Neural style transfer's misunderstanding of abstract art - texture-as-style versus the artist's method of making
cases.evidence_pack: alongside neural style transfer as a point of comparison for computational approaches to abstract art
cases.evidence_recon: An Analytical-Drawing Interface as a Counter-Method to Neural Style Transfer ... This paper takes the opposite stance as its starting provocation.

cases.artist_object: Re-appreciating the overlooked beauty of natural phenomena in everyday life (leaves swaying in wind); uncontrollable randomness respected rather than discarded as noise
cases.evidence_pack: tilting motion is produced silently by moving liquid inside each object with handmade electrohydrodynamic (EHD) pumps [no nature/beauty/randomness theme in pack]
cases.evidence_recon: see-saw turns the seesaw into a study of hidden redistribution.

cases.artist_object: Bias in the gaze of AI; the work as an AI mirror prompting reflection on data surveillance
cases.evidence_pack: The topic area sits at the intersection of AI/machine vision, data surveillance, appearance-based identity signals, and the visual language of X-ray imaging
cases.evidence_recon: the X-ray, a medium culturally trusted to reveal a hidden interior, is repurposed here as an instrument of fabrication rather than disclosure

cases.artist_object: Aura in the age of reproduction (Benjamin): whether aura can be chained to a reproducible digital process
cases.evidence_pack: questions of reproduction and uniqueness in contemporary photographic art [plus two Walter Benjamin entries in input/bibliography.bib]
cases.evidence_recon: whether the values that alternative-process photographers attach to one-off, unrepeatable making can be carried into a fully digital pipeline

cases.artist_object: Symbiosis of AI cognition and human perception - AI's cognitive distortions mirroring bias in human-annotated data
cases.evidence_pack: uses participant-driven labeling together with AI-generated street-view alterations as its central material [no cognition/bias theme in pack]
cases.evidence_recon: the resulting city is neither the machine's understanding nor a person's, but a hybrid artifact of the two

cases.artist_object: "Dance in the Painting" as a new art form fusing tradition and modernity; multimodal generation renewing classical Chinese art
cases.evidence_pack: applying image style transfer and video-to-music generation to footage of Chinese dance, rendering the dance in a traditional Chinese ink painting style
cases.evidence_recon: the montage stages a recursive translation in which no layer holds priority as "the original"

cases.artist_object: Dual Reality - real and virtual worlds distinct yet reflecting, influencing and merging through embedded sensor/actuator networks
cases.evidence_pack: a large-scale knitted electronic-textile architectural pavilion and a paired virtual-reality system that exchanges real-time sensor data with it
cases.evidence_recon: architecture need not be a passive container: when its very skin is woven to listen, the structure becomes an instrument

cases.artist_object: Fungal morphology recast as a 2D graphic time-series generation problem, giving Bio-Art artists a zero-coding simulation route
cases.evidence_pack: A project at the intersection of bio-art and computer graphics ... spans image segmentation, time-series prediction, cellular-automata simulation
cases.evidence_recon: The framing I invent for this work ... is authorship by negotiation.

cases.artist_object: "What is it like to be a bat?" - eco-phenomenological MR, more-than-human perception and ecological empathy
cases.evidence_pack: in the context of ecological education and non-human sensory perception
cases.evidence_recon: This paper situates EchoVision as a practice-based inquiry into non-human sensory perception

cases.artist_object: "What if the observer becomes the observed?" - the human body as apparatus of observation; sensing that reflects rather than detects
cases.evidence_pack: establishing a feedback loop in which the user alternates between being observed and observing their own embodied expression
cases.evidence_recon: We frame the resulting artifact as a mistranslating instrument ... it earns its expressive value precisely through the gap between gesture and word

cases.artist_object: Queer and disabled embodied identity as a site of creative agency; reclaiming technical space through personal ritual
cases.evidence_pack: a blind, low-vision musician who also identifies as queer
cases.evidence_recon: designing a music interface around one performer's existing tactile habit ... lets us treat legibility as something authored by the hand

cases.artist_object: Machines see but do not perceive; individual human memory integrated into machine visual interpretation bridges that gap
cases.evidence_pack: This project sits at the intersection of machine visual interpretation and human memory.
cases.evidence_recon: the personal memory archive is the suture that re-subjectifies that gaze

cases.artist_object: Zoe, an immortal artificial life: human/AI emotional asymmetry and loneliness told from a more-than-human perspective
cases.evidence_pack: connects to a speculative-fiction narrative about an artificial life form
cases.evidence_recon: rendering involuntary public emotional disclosure as navigable beauty is an ethical act, not merely an analytical one
